entities.name: Sanhedrin
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The supreme judicial and legislative body of the Jewish people in ancient Palestine. Composed of 71 elders, it adjudicated religious law and served as the highest court until the destruction of the Second Temple in 70 CE.
